messages:
Anna D.: FYI I opened a docs PR for the private/on-prem network + KMS examples. Need a quick pass for accuracy before I merge: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
Jasper: Thanks — linking it. Quick ask: can we add a short migration note for nftables users? a few customers hit nftables vs iptables in the installer.
Marco (infra): Yes please. Also call out firewalld and podman network gotchas. I can paste the minimal nftables rule we used on the test lab.
Anna D.: Awesome. I added a TODO comment in the PR for nftables but haven't written the snippet. Marco, can you add the exact rule text?
Marco (infra): Pasting below — tested on Rocky 9 lab. Use carefully:

```
# allow control plane ports
nft add table inet redwood
nft add chain inet redwood input { type filter hook input priority 0; }
nft add rule inet redwood input tcp dport {443,6000,10250} ct state new,established accept
nft add rule inet redwood input udp dport 53 accept
```

Marco (infra): Note: 6000/tcp is the KMS proxy port we use in private deployments. Mention it in the preflight checklist.
Elena (security): Please also document that customers using HSM via PKCS#11 must open outbound TLS to KMS endpoints or ensure their HSM proxy can reach the control plane. Add a note about mutual TLS requirement for the HSM client.
Samir: On the SDK side, we should add a short Python example showing how to call the local KMS proxy with client certs. I'll drop a snippet.
Samir: Snippet (small):

```
import requests
from requests import Session

s = Session()
s.cert = ("/etc/redwood/certs/client.crt", "/etc/redwood/certs/client.key")
resp = s.post("https://127.0.0.1:6000/v1/decrypt", json={"ciphertext":"BASE64"}, timeout=30)
print(resp.json())
```

Anna D.: Great — please add that into the "KMS examples" section. Also need a short troubleshooting paragraph for air-gapped installs when customers import the runtime image tarball.
Jasper: For image import, we usually recommend `ctr image import` (containerd) or `podman load`. Add both commands and point to the archive format we publish.
Jasper: Example command: `sudo ctr -n=k8s.io images import redwood-runtime-1.4.2.tar`
Anna D.: I added a link to the release notes where the tarball checksum lives but CI flagged a broken anchor: docs/releases#runtime-1-4-2. docs-bot shows a 404 on preview.
docs-bot: Automated check: broken anchor detected in sources/docs/onprem/setup.md -> line 142 (docs/releases#runtime-1-4-2).
Anna D.: Who owns that releases page?
Marco (infra): That's on the release notes repo, I can fix the anchor — it changed during the last restructure. Will push a patch.
Elena (security): Also flag: the networking checklist should warn about MTU mismatches across site-to-site VPNs. We saw dropped packets on long sequences with default 1500 vs vxlan. Add the table of recommended MTU values.
Samir: One more nit — the Python SDK example used `timeout=5`. For private deployments with HSM roundtrips, recommend `timeout=30` in examples.
Anna D.: Good catch, Samir. I'll update the snippet and bump the timeout.
Jasper: When you update, please squash the tiny WIP commits — PR history is noisy. Also add a one-line entry to the migration guide: "If switching kernels or nft -> iptables compatibility layers, restart kubelet after rule import".
Anna D.: Will do. I'm also adding a short FAQ item: "Why does my HSM client fail on first decrypt?" with answers about clock skew, cert chain, and DNS in air-gapped setups.
Marco (infra): For the DNS note, include the resolv.conf fallback snippet we used in the lab: `options rotate timeout:2` and a comment about split-horizon DNS for private endpoint names.
Elena (security): Approving from security POV once Samir's cert example is in and the mTLS requirement is explicit.
Samir: Done — pushed cert example and timeout change.
Anna D.: Thanks all. I updated the PR: added nftables block, SDK snippet with 30s timeout, image import commands, and an MTU note. Marco — if you can submit the release-anchor fix, I can merge after a quick sanity pass.
Marco (infra): I'll open a tiny PR to release notes in 10m.
Anna D.: Merging after infra PR lands. Leaving the thread open if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Deploy preview for docs site succeeded — https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood-inference.internal/482 — visual diff: 2 files changed.
Anna D.: Preview looks good to me, merging now. Thanks everyone!
